project_scope: Refactor the sticker configurator canvas collision system from push-apart to constrained drag — items follow the mouse but are wall-collided against other items so they can never enter an overlapping position. Remove all push-apart logic entirely.
business_deliverables: Constrained drag: dragged item's position is clamped to stay outside all other item rects + GAP — it can never overlap during movement
Collision resolution via overlap depth + GAP push (not spiral search) for post-drop, paste, resize, and alignment operations
No push-apart at any stage — the system prevents overlap, not repairs it
findNearestClearSpot v2: linear nudge along axis of least overlap depth, not spiral
Overlap validation after all structural operations (paste, duplicate, resize, align, distribute, auto-arrange)

interaction_patterns: Constrained drag — item wall-collides against other items, never enters overlap
No push-apart vibration during drag (item stays at mouse position, not rubber-banding)
Red outline + opacity only appears if overlap is INTENTIONALLY forced (paste, align, or extreme resize)
Post-overlap resolution: single linear nudge (overlap + GAP), not spiral search

requirements: Red outline for overlap state uses high contrast (#FF4444 against any background)
Reduced-motion: overlap resolution snaps instantly, no animation

dependencies.note: Vanilla JS only. All files are ES6 classes within assets/sticker-configurator/. No framework.

pipeline_sequence_notes: This is a pure JavaScript refactor of 4 files in assets/sticker-configurator/. No Liquid or CSS changes needed. The Architect must produce an ADR specifying the exact collision math, constrained drag algorithm, and per-file change specifications. The Auditor must verify no edge cases (multi-drag, resize-into-overlap, paste-then-overlap). The Constructor implements the JS changes. The Optimizer should skip this pass or only verify no regressions.
